assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The submitted SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are provisional rough geometry supplied by the repository workflow, not official planning redlines.
assumptions.impact: All land-use, area, ratio, network, phasing, drawing and manifest results must be regenerated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Concept building footprints express programme distribution and renewal method only; they are not surveyed existing buildings or approved new construction.
assumptions.impact: Retain, retrofit, infill and demolition decisions require building, ownership, heritage, fire and structural surveys.

assumptions.statement: The slow-mobility spine and cross-links are concept alignments inside the provisional boundary.
assumptions.impact: Road redlines, station interfaces, crossings, bridge structures, accessibility and traffic safety require specialist review.

assumptions.statement: The CLAIM-SANDBOX-LICENSE-OBSERVE-AUDIT-EXIT protocol is a public-interest design proposal, not an enacted regulation or government commitment.
assumptions.impact: Legal basis, responsible authorities, data protection, incident reporting and appeals must be co-designed before implementation.

assumptions.statement: Event, community, testbed and public-interface operations are reference mechanisms without confirmed operators, budgets or schedules.
assumptions.impact: Each project requires an accountable operator, public engagement, safety plan, copyright clearance and exit conditions.
